outputs.explanation: Spatial expression panels are heatmap-style overlays on tissue images, not averaged summary plots requiring individual data points.
Panel B contains only micrograph/RNAscope images, no plots of averaged data.
Dot plot displays all individual patient tumor data points (n=500 LUSC, n=512 LUAD) with median and 95% CI overlaid.
Bar chart (mean ± SD) has individual replicate data points overlaid as dots for each of the four groups.
